topic: Calculating impressions with dynamic loop duration
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding the formula for calculating impressions when the loop duration changes. One participant noted that their side does not include loop duration in the calculation, leading to questions about how the change affects impression counts.

A separate point was raised concerning client requirements: instead of selecting a specific cycle duration (e.g., 60/120/180 seconds), the client prefers to select the number of spots plus the number of cycles. The spot and cycle durations are sourced from a database, which the client is unaware of.
decisions: The calculation method for impressions when loop duration changes needs further clarification.
action_items: Discuss the client's preferred selection model (spots + cycles) versus fixed durations during tomorrow's daily meeting; one participant will provide an update after clarification.
